† [נָעַל] vb.denom. furnish with sandals, shoe (𝔗 נְעַל (rare), bind on sandal; Arabic نَعَلَ furnish with sandals, shoe horse or camel; Syriac ܢܰܥܶܠ shoe horse);—
Qal Impf. 1 s. sf. וָאֶנְעֲלֵךְ תָּ֑הַשׁ Ez 16:10 and I shod thee with תחשׁ (q.v.).
Hiph. Impf. 3 mpl. sf. וַיַּנְעִלוּם 2 Ch 28:15 and gave them sandals.
